questions.explain: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom; Edom means red, from the red pottage.

choices: Mount Seir, the clefts of the rock
questions.explain: Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose pride hath deceived thee (Obadiah 1:3).
Amalek came of a concubine, a lesser wife.

questions.q: Who inhabited mount Seir before Esau?
questions.explain: The Lord destroyed the Horims from before the children of Esau (Deuteronomy 2:22).

questions.q: What are the dukes of Edom?
choices: The chiefs of their tribes, the leaders of Edom's families
questions.explain: These were the dukes of the sons of Esau.
